description: This file defines the SessionSubscriber class, which is an event subscriber in the OrangeHRM application. It listens for HTTP request events and manages user session invalidation based on session idle time.

classes.name: SessionSubscriber
classes.description: An event subscriber class that listens for request events and manages session activity and invalidation.

methods.name: getSubscribedEvents
methods.description: Returns an array indicating the events this subscriber listens to, specifically the kernel request event with high priority.

methods.name: onRequestEvent
methods.description: Handles the request event, retrieves the session, and invalidates it if the session has been idle longer than the configured maximum session idle time.
